user.title: Create Limit Helper
user.description: Categorize a numeric sensor into multi-tier limit zones (e.g. low, normal, high, critical) with optional hysteresis, without writing Jinja2 template sensors.

data_description.source_entity: Select a numeric sensor (e.g., battery, temperature, CO2, humidity, power) or input_number helper.
data_description.preset: Select a standard configuration preset or choose 'Custom' to define your own thresholds and labels.
data_description.labels: Names for each zone separated by comma (e.g. 'critical, low, medium, good'). Must have one more label than thresholds.
data_description.hysteresis: Buffer added to thresholds to prevent bouncing between zones when values fluctuate.

error.empty_source: Please select a numeric target entity.
error.empty_thresholds: Please specify at least one threshold value.
